# Variable `SDKIMAGE_FEATURES`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

Equivalent to IMAGE_FEATURES. However, this variable applies to the SDK generated from an image using the following command:

```
$ bitbake -c populate_sdk imagename

```

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-SDKIMAGE_FEATURES)
